info.name: Blood Donation & Emergency Platform - Unified API Collection
info.description:
Official Single Unified Postman Collection for Blood Donation & Emergency Assistance Platform Backend.
All phases are organized into dedicated folders with automated bearer token assignment and environment variable chaining.

item.name: Phase 1 - Auth & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
item.description: Endpoints 1-5: User registration (Donor/Recipient), Login, GCP Google OAuth Social Login, Refresh Token, Logout.

request.description:
### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Root health check and welcome entrypoint for the Blood Donation & Emergency Assistance Platform API.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public (No Authorization header required)`

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns API operational status, semantic version, and quick-start links.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `500 Internal Server Error (If database or system is down)`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Ideal for uptime monitors and load balancer health probes (AWS, Vercel, Docker).

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Registers a new user with the DONOR role and automatically creates their associated Donor Profile.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `name` | string (min 2 chars, required) |
| `email` | string (valid email format, unique, required) |
| `password` | string (min 6 chars, required, hashed via bcryptjs) |
| `role` | 'DONOR' (enum, required) |
| `phone` | string (valid mobile format, required) |
| `address` | string (residential address, required) |
| `bloodGroup` | 'A_POSITIVE' | 'A_NEGATIVE' | 'B_POSITIVE' | 'B_NEGATIVE' | 'AB_POSITIVE' | 'AB_NEGATIVE' | 'O_POSITIVE' | 'O_NEGATIVE' (required for DONOR) |
| `latitude` | number (-90 to 90, required for proximity matching) |
| `longitude` | number (-180 to 180, required for proximity matching) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `201 Created - Returns user object, donor profile, accessToken, and sets refreshToken cookie.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Validation error or invalid blood group`
- `409 Conflict - Email already registered in system`
- `429 Too Many Requests - Exceeded registration rate limit`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Test script automatically extracts and stores `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `donorUserId` in Postman collection variables.

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Registers a new user with the RECIPIENT role (patients, hospitals, or families seeking emergency blood donations).

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `name` | string (min 2 chars, required) |
| `email` | string (valid email format, unique, required) |
| `password` | string (min 6 chars, required) |
| `role` | 'RECIPIENT' (enum, required) |
| `phone` | string (required) |
| `address` | string (required) |
| `latitude` | number (optional, used as default request location) |
| `longitude` | number (optional, used as default request location) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `201 Created - Returns user object, accessToken, and refreshToken cookie.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Validation error`
- `409 Conflict - Email already registered`
- `429 Too Many Requests - Exceeded registration rate limit`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Test script automatically captures and stores `recipientAccessToken` and `recipientUserId` in Postman collection variables.

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Authenticates an Administrator user using email and password credentials.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `email` | string (admin email, required, e.g. admin@emergency.com) |
| `password` | string (admin password, required, e.g. Admin@123) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns admin profile details, JWT accessToken, and sets refreshToken HTTP-only cookie.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Missing credentials`
- `401 Unauthorized - Incorrect password`
- `403 Forbidden - Account is blocked/suspended by another admin`
- `404 Not Found - Admin email not registered`
- `429 Too Many Requests - Brute-force rate limiter triggered`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Test script stores `adminAccessToken` in collection variables for administrative moderation tests.

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Authenticates a registered Donor user to access donor-specific workflows and donation matching.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `email` | string (donor email, required) |
| `password` | string (donor password, required) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns user details, donor profile, active donation stats, and JWT accessToken.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `401 Unauthorized - Invalid credentials`
- `403 Forbidden - Account suspended/blocked`
- `404 Not Found - User does not exist`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Test script stores `donorAccessToken` and `accessToken` in collection variables.

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Verifies Google OAuth2 ID Token via Google Identity Services and creates or logs in the user session.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `idToken` | string (Google JWT ID Token obtained from Google Sign-In SDK, required) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns user profile, accessToken, and sets refreshToken cookie.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Missing or malformed idToken`
- `401 Unauthorized - Invalid or expired Google signature / wrong audience`
- `403 Forbidden - Associated account is suspended`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Uses google-auth-library to securely verify token signature against Google Public Keys (certs).

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Generates a new short-lived JWT Access Token using an active, valid Refresh Token.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public (Token provided in body or HTTP-only cookie)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `refreshToken` | string (valid JWT refresh token, optional if passed via Cookie) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns a newly signed JWT accessToken valid for the configured TTL (e.g. 1d).`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Refresh token missing`
- `401 Unauthorized - Refresh token expired or signature invalid`
- `403 Forbidden - User account blocked since token was issued`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Test script updates `accessToken` in collection variables with the newly rotated access token.

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Terminates user session by clearing the HTTP-only refreshToken cookie and invalidating credentials.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public / Authenticated`

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Clears refreshToken cookie with expired Max-Age.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `500 Internal Server Error - Unexpected server error`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Ensures secure cleanup across browsers and mobile clients.

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `401 Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer token`
- `403 Forbidden - User account blocked`

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Updates personal contact information, residential address, and geolocation coordinates of the authenticated user.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (Any Authenticated Role)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{accessToken}}`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `name` | string (optional) |
| `phone` | string (optional) |
| `address` | string (optional) |
| `latitude` | number (-90 to 90, optional, updates proximity baseline) |
| `longitude` | number (-180 to 180, optional, updates proximity baseline) |

**✅ Success Response:**

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**

- `401 Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token`

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Updates donor-specific attributes such as blood group, availability for emergency calls, and medical fitness notes.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (DONOR role strictly required)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{donorAccessToken}}`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `bloodGroup` | 'A_POSITIVE' | 'A_NEGATIVE' | 'B_POSITIVE' | 'B_NEGATIVE' | 'AB_POSITIVE' | 'AB_NEGATIVE' | 'O_POSITIVE' | 'O_NEGATIVE' (optional) |
| `isAvailable` | boolean (optional, toggle readiness to donate) |
| `medicalConditions` | string (optional, health or allergy disclosure) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns updated donor profile details.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Invalid blood group format`
- `401 Unauthorized - Missing token`
- `403 Forbidden - Caller does not have DONOR role`

item.name: 5. Forbidden Check (Recipient Cannot Update Donor Profile)

request.description:

Security verification asserting that a RECIPIENT token cannot access or update the donor profile endpoint.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (RECIPIENT role)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{recipientAccessToken}}`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `isAvailable` | boolean (true) |

**✅ Success Response:**

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `403 Forbidden - Role RECIPIENT is not authorized for donor-profile`

request.description:
### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Creates a new urgent blood request for a patient in a designated hospital.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (RECIPIENT or ADMIN)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{recipientAccessToken}}`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `patientName` | string (required, e.g. Rafiqul Islam) |
| `hospitalName` | string (required, e.g. Dhaka Medical College Hospital) |
| `hospitalAddress` | string (required, e.g. Secretariate Rd, Dhaka 1000) |
| `bloodGroup` | 'A_POSITIVE' | 'A_NEGATIVE' | 'B_POSITIVE' | 'B_NEGATIVE' | 'AB_POSITIVE' | 'AB_NEGATIVE' | 'O_POSITIVE' | 'O_NEGATIVE' (required) |
| `units` | integer (min 1, max 10, required, units of blood needed) |
| `urgency` | 'REGULAR' | 'URGENT' | 'CRITICAL' (required) |
| `neededBy` | ISO-8601 string (e.g. 2026-10-25T14:00:00.000Z, required) |
| `latitude` | number (hospital GPS latitude, required for proximity matching) |
| `longitude` | number (hospital GPS longitude, required for proximity matching) |
| `contactNumber` | string (required, contact number for hospital coordination) |
| `notes` | string (optional, additional clinical instructions) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `201 Created - Returns created blood request record with initial status 'PENDING'.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Validation error (e.g. past neededBy date)`
- `401 Unauthorized - Missing or invalid token`
- `403 Forbidden - DONOR role cannot create requests`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Test script stores `requestId` in Postman collection variables.

request.description:
### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Fetches a paginated list of active blood requests supporting multi-attribute filtering, sorting, and pagination.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public (Open for public browsing by donors and relief organizations)`

**🔍 Parameters (Path / Query):**
- `page`: integer (default 1, optional)
- `limit`: integer (default 10, optional)
- `bloodGroup`: 'A_POSITIVE' | ... (optional filter)
- `urgency`: 'CRITICAL' | 'URGENT' | 'REGULAR' (optional filter)
- `status`: 'PENDING' | 'ACCEPTED' | 'FULFILLED' | 'CANCELED' (optional)
- `sortBy`: string (e.g. 'createdAt', 'neededBy', 'urgency', default 'createdAt')
- `sortOrder`: 'asc' | 'desc' (default 'desc')

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns { meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages }, data: [...] }.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Invalid query parameters`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Automatically excludes records where `isDeleted: true`.

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Executes full-text keyword search across patient names, hospital names, and hospital addresses.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public`

**🔍 Parameters (Path / Query):**
- `searchTerm`: string (keyword query, e.g. 'Dhaka Medical')

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns matching blood requests with pagination metadata.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request`

item.name: 4. Get Single Blood Request by ID

request.description:
### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Retrieves complete details of a specific blood request by its unique UUID.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public`

**🔍 Parameters (Path / Query):**
- `id`: string (UUID route parameter, {{requestId}})

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns complete blood request details including recipient info, donations, and payment logs.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `404 Not Found - Request does not exist or has been soft-deleted`

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Modifies fields of an active blood request (e.g. adjusting required units, urgency, or notes).

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (Owner RECIPIENT or ADMIN)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{recipientAccessToken}}`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**🔍 Parameters (Path / Query):**
- `id`: string (UUID route parameter, {{requestId}})

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `hospitalAddress` | string (optional) |
| `units` | integer (optional) |
| `urgency` | 'REGULAR' | 'URGENT' | 'CRITICAL' (optional) |
| `notes` | string (optional) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns updated blood request record.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Validation error`
- `401 Unauthorized - Invalid token`
- `403 Forbidden - Caller is neither the owner nor an ADMIN`
- `404 Not Found - Blood request not found`

### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Soft deletes an active blood request, marking `isDeleted: true` and transitioning status to `CANCELED`.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (Owner RECIPIENT or ADMIN)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{recipientAccessToken}}`

**🔍 Parameters (Path / Query):**
- `id`: string (UUID route parameter, {{requestId}})

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns soft-deleted blood request confirmation.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `401 Unauthorized`
- `403 Forbidden - Caller does not own the request`
- `404 Not Found`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Preserves historical data and payment audit logs while hiding the request from public searches.

item.name: Phase 4 - Intelligent Matching, Concurrency & Donation Workflow
item.description: Endpoints 14-17: Blood compatibility lookup, Haversine proximity matching, Concurrency-safe donor acceptance transaction (PostgreSQL ACID row-locking), Donation status lifecycle (COMPLETED/CANCELLED), 90-day medical cooldown tracking, and personal donation history.

exec: pm.test('Response contains compatible blood groups and donor list', function () {

request.description:
### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Discovers active, eligible donors compatible with the blood request based on medical ABO compatibility rules and proximity.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (RECIPIENT or ADMIN)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{recipientAccessToken}}`

**🔍 Parameters (Path / Query):**
- `id`: string (UUID route parameter, {{requestId}})

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns array of compatible donors with calculated distance (km) ranked closest first.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `401 Unauthorized`
- `403 Forbidden - Non-owner recipient or unauthorized role`
- `404 Not Found - Blood request not found`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Uses Haversine formula on hospital vs donor latitude/longitude. Donors within the 90-day cooldown are automatically excluded.

item.name: 14b. Find Matching Donors with Distance Filter (10 km)

request.description:

Discovers matching donors filtered strictly within a maximum geographic radius (e.g. 10 km).

- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{recipientAccessToken}}`

**🔍 Parameters (Path / Query):**
- `id`: string (UUID route parameter, {{requestId}})
- `maxDistanceKm`: number (e.g. 10, query parameter)

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns compatible donors within 10km radius sorted by proximity.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Invalid distance number`
- `404 Not Found`

item.name: Phase 5 - Real bKash Payments
item.description: Endpoints 18-20: Official bKash Tokenized Checkout API integration. Create payment, bKash callback & payment execution, transaction verification, AuditLog persistence, and payment record lookup with RBAC.

exec: pm.test('Payment initiated with bkashURL and paymentId', function () {

request.description:
### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Initiates a bKash Tokenized Checkout payment to fund emergency ambulance and blood logistics transport.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Bearer Token (RECIPIENT or ADMIN)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{recipientAccessToken}}`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `requestId` | string (UUID of associated blood request, required, {{requestId}}) |
| `amount` | number (positive BDT amount, e.g. 500, required) |
| `purpose` | string (e.g. 'Emergency ambulance transport fee', required) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `201 Created - Returns local payment record, bKash paymentID, and `bkashURL` redirect gateway URL.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Invalid amount or missing requestId`
- `401 Unauthorized`
- `404 Not Found - Blood request does not exist`
- `502 Bad Gateway - bKash gateway connection failure`

> **💡 Implementation Note:** Test script captures `paymentId` and `bkashPaymentId` in collection variables.

exec: pm.test('Payment executed and status is COMPLETED with trxID', function () {

request.description:
### 📋 Endpoint Overview
Handles bKash Tokenized Checkout callback, executes transaction with bKash, and writes an audit log.

**🔒 Access Control & Authentication:**
`Public / Webhook Callback (bKash Gateway)`

**📨 Request Headers:**
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

**📦 Request Body Schema (JSON):**
| Field | Description / Constraints |
|---|---|
| `paymentID` | string (bKash payment ID, {{bkashPaymentId}}, required) |
| `status` | 'success' | 'failure' | 'cancel' (required) |

**✅ Success Response:**
- `200 OK - Returns completed payment record with bKash trxID, invoice number, and execution timestamp.`

**❌ Potential Error Responses:**
- `400 Bad Request - Payment canceled or failed at bKash gateway`
